name: Cube-Chordal Ample Classes Are Not Contained in ACC Graphs
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Cube-Chordal Ample Classes belongs to ACC Graphs.
proof: The daisy Q_3 minus 111 has three maximal squares. Their pairwise-only word occurrences force a triangle in any proposed join tree.
